inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver counted in the child-caregiver ratio was present in the infant classroom without an Eligible background check.       Note: The caregiver was asked by the director to leave the premises. The caregiver left the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device: Based on the information gathered during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that children are left in time out for long periods of time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Using Inappropriate Long Period of Silence or Inactivity Including Requiring Child to Remain in a Restrictive Device (26 TAC §746.2805(10))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: Based on the information received during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that children in care are inappropriately disciplined.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Based on the information gathered during the DFPS investigation there is sufficient evidence to support the caregiver did not use good judgement by making children stand in a corner facing a wall and placing their hands over their heads and or on their heads.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Based on the information received during the DFPS investigation, there is sufficient evidence to support that children are allowed non-activity guided screen time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: Children 2 years old and younger were observed watching television.       Note: This was corrected at inspection with the caregiver powered off the television and took the children to another class for free play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Annual Sanitation Inspection: The operation did not have a current sanitation inspection available for review during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Annual Sanitation Inspection (26 TAC §746.3401(a))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities: Two school age children were observed on their cell phones, not related to a planned activity.       Note: this was corrected at inspection when the caregiver instructed the children to put the phones away.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Related to Planned Activities (26 TAC §746.2207(c)(1))

occurrences.finding: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated: Several medication forms for children in care is not signed by the parent.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Medication Authorization - Signed and Dated (26 TAC §746.3803(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes: All fire drills for the year of 2022 exceeded the 3 minute required exit time.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Drill Monthly - Exit in 3 Minutes (26 TAC §746.5205(1))

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking.: A caregiver counted in the child-caregiver ratio did not have current pediatric first aid training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric first aid with rescue breathing and choking. (26 TAC §746.1315(a))

occurrences.finding: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year: There were 0 of 4 lock down drills conducted for the year of 2022.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Sheltering Drills for Lock-Down-4 times in a calendar year (26 TAC §746.5205(3))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The entry door to the infant classroom is loose and portion of the door is hanging off the hinges.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR: A caregiver counted in the child-caregiver ratio did not have current pediatric CPR  training.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Each Caregiver and the Director Must Have Current Training in pediatric CPR (26 TAC §746.1315(b))

occurrences.finding: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program: 6 children in care did not have a required health statement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Health Statement - Written, dated within past year, indicates child is physically able to participate in operation's child-care program (26 TAC §746.611(a)(1))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities: The caregiver in charge was also counted in child-caregiver ratio.       Note: This was corrected when the director arrived at the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Free of other activities (26 TAC §746.1203(6))

occurrences.finding: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements: 4 out 5 staff did not have proof of education in their personnel file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Personnel Records- Meets Requirements (26 TAC §746.901(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information: Seven (7) children who are transported by the operation did not have emergency medical transport and treatment authorization forms
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - Emergency Medical Information (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity: The parent handbook was missing the following policies regarding activities:    The benefits of physical activity and outdoor play;    The duration of physical activity at your operation, both indoor and outdoor; and     The  plan to ensure physical activity occurs on days when extreme weather conditions prohibit or limit outdoor play.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Operational Policies - Promotion of Physical Activity (26 TAC §746.501(a)(18))

occurrences.finding: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact: One child's record was missing the address for the emergency contact.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Admission Information - Emergency Contact (26 TAC §746.605(6))
